processDescription: Thread rolling cold-forms threads by displacing material between two reciprocating or rotary dies, rather than cutting it away. Compressive residual stress at the thread root increases fatigue strength by 30–50% compared to cut threads, specifically for screws. Precision screws for fasteners present unique challenges: thread form accuracy per ASME B1.1 with Class 3A fit. Micro-screws (< M2) require Swiss turning with CBN tooling.
heatControl: Cold forming process — no heat generated. Water-soluble lubricant applied to dies for galling prevention on titanium.
flatnessControl: Head flatness and perpendicularity within 0.05 mm per fastener standards. Die alignment verified with optical setup microscope.
